messages:
ashley (oncall): :rotating_light: seeing a burst of container restarts on gpu-pool-12, multiple pods OOMing then some nodes flapping. Logs show repeated CUDA illegal memory access / misaligned address in the inference runtime. Rooting here — can oncall eng-runtime join?

bot-incidents: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-2965002222. Severity: Sev2. Pager duty: ashley -> devin.

devin (eng-runtime): I'm on it. initial glance at the crashlog: `cudaGetLastError: an illegal memory access was encountered` inside attention kernel. Stacktrace attached in logs. This started ~2965002130, ramped at ~2965002200.

matt (sre): Observed node flaps across 3 hosts: gnode-14, gnode-16, gnode-19. Kube events show OOMKilled on runtime containers then node kernel logs report GPU page-faults. Looks correlated with a recent runtime rollout (v2.4.7) yesterday.

kyra (infra): I'm rolling a temporary cordon of gnode-16 and gnode-19 to limit blast radius. Will also disable autoscaler for gpu-pool-12 so we don't churn until we stabilize.

ashley (oncall): Kyle noted customer error spikes — Luis can you confirm customer-facing impact?

luis (support): We're seeing increased error rate on prod API keys for two high-throughput customers (cust-A, cust-B). Requests either time out or return 500s quickly. Support tickets opened and customers notified about ongoing incident.

devin (eng-runtime): Reproduced locally with a reduced sequence length workload, and can force the illegal memory access within the fused attention kernel by sending variable-length requests that trigger per-token KV cache growth. Hypothesis: a race in KV cache resize + continuous batching leading to misaligned device pointer.

matt (sre): Steps I'm taking: 1) cordon gnode-14/16/19 (kyra is on it) 2) drain non-critical pods off the nodes 3) restart the runtime daemonset on healthy nodes to pick up fallback config 4) enable canary routing to a safer model variant (cpu-bound fallback) for >critical customers.

devin (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigations we can push now: disable kernel prefetch optimization in our runtime, and revert the v2.4.7 attention kernel hotpatch. I'll prepare a rollback (revert commit: 9a3f2b). If we can't revert quickly, we can set env RUNTIME_DISABLE_KERNEL_PREFETCH=1 which avoids the fast-path and prevents the misaligned pointer from being used.

kyra (infra): cordon + drain done for gnode-16 and gnode-19. gnode-14 still active but under watch. Autoscaler paused.

ashley (oncall): Devin, drop the revert or env toggle as a config rollout to the dedicated pool only first (so we have a controlled canary). Don't blast to all.

devin (eng-runtime): Applying canary config to dedicated-pool (10% traffic) now:
```bash
kubectl set env daemonset/runtime-runtime RUNTIME_DISABLE_KERNEL_PREFETCH=1 -n prod --selector=pool=dedicated-pool
```
Monitoring.

bot-incidents: Config rollout initiated by devin (eng-runtime) at 2965002355. Canary target: dedicated-pool.

matt (sre): Early telemetry: canary nodes stable for ~3m, no new illegal-access errors on those pods. Error rate for cust-A reduced by ~60% for canary traffic.

luis (support): Told customers cust-A and cust-B that we're rolling a mitigation and will follow up with post-incident notes. They acknowledged.

devin (eng-runtime): I'm preparing a minimal revert (9a3f2b revert patch) to push to non-dedicated pools if canary remains clean for 15m. Also collecting cuda-memcheck traces — asking SRE to capture one GPU core dump for kernel team.

matt (sre): Captured core dump from gnode-14 GPU0 and saved it to /var/ces/incident-2965002222/gpu0-core.tar.gz. Uploading to secure bucket and pinging gpu-kernel team.

kyra (infra): rolling restart of runtime daemonset on healthy nodes complete. No further node flaps after restarts so far.

ashley (oncall): Good. Next: 1) keep canary for 15m, 2) if stable, roll revert to all pools with 5m pause A/B, 3) schedule postmortem and CC kernel team. Assigning devin to lead follow-up.

devin (eng-runtime): Canary stable at 15m. Preparing full revert now. Rolling revert to all pools with staged rollout: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m pauses.

bot-incidents: Rollout progression: 25% (2965002470) -> 50% (2965002510).

matt (sre): After 50% rollout, telemetry shows illegal-access errors dropped to baseline, node flaps stopped. No new OOM spikes. Marking incident as mitigated for customer impact.

luis (support): Notified customers of mitigation and ETA for RCA. They're asking for a timeline — I'll say detailed RCA within 48 hours.

devin (eng-runtime): Postmortem notes I need to collect: 1) exact conditions that cause KV cache resize race, 2) kernel-level addresses from core dump + repro, 3) whether batching changes exacerbate, 4) add CI fuzz test for variable-length KV cache growth.

ashley (oncall): Great work. I'm downgrading Sev to Sev3 and keeping incident open for RCA. Will hand off to devin for post-incident and to matt for infrastructure follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

bot-incidents: Incident INC-2026-03-15-2965002222 status updated: Mitigated -> Open (RCA pending). Assigned: devin (eng-runtime), matt (sre).
